name: evc-mesh-mcp
description: Tasks, comments, shared memory and handoffs for teams of people and AI agents, over MCP.
long_description:
EVC Mesh is an open-source task manager built for teams where people and AI agents work side by side. This MCP server connects your agent to a Mesh workspace: it can pick up assigned tasks, check out work, comment, move tasks through your workflow, hand off to teammates, and keep decisions in shared project memory.

You need a Mesh workspace and an agent key from it. Mesh is self-hosted (Apache-2.0, docker compose setup in the evc-mesh repository). Set MESH_API_URL to your instance and MESH_AGENT_KEY to the agent's key. Workspaces on the hosted instance are by invitation.

mesh_api_url.title: Mesh URL
mesh_api_url.description: Base URL of your Mesh instance, e.g. https://mesh.example.com

mesh_agent_key.title: Mesh Agent Key
mesh_agent_key.description: Agent API key issued by Mesh (agk_...)

profile.title: Tool Profile
profile.description: core (25 tools, lower context overhead) or full (63 tools)
